diagnosis.description: Agent treated unverified P50 reserve estimate as P90 actionable truth. The agent lacked a floor-level gate distinguishing 'computed estimate' from 'witnessed fact' in subsurface workflows.

reaffirmations.evidence: Cross-validated against CMAG ECS framework: epistemic_integrity degradation pattern matches unconstrained agent behavior
GEOX claim engine confirms: no tri-witness attestation existed for the P50 estimate at time of use
Constitutional review: F2 violation (unlabeled estimate) + F8 violation (G < 0.80 for high-stakes action)

value.name: SUBSURFACE_EPISTEMIC_GATE
value.rule: All subsurface data classified 'PROSPECT' must carry epistemic label ≥ DER with explicit witness_count ≥ 2 before use in economic baseline generation. P50 ≠ P90: reserve estimates must state their confidence band in the claim itself, not just in metadata.

value.name: PROSPECT_DOUBLE_GATE
value.rule: Prospect evaluation with downstream irreversible commitment (drilling, lease, fiscal) requires F8/F11 double gate: G ≥ 0.80 AND full audit trail with constitutional_chain_id. Single-gate G pass is insufficient for irreversible subsurface actions.
value.operator: G ≥ 0.80 AND cc_id IS NOT NULL
